default: no commit rule: every message passes
people: {id}, the email of the people entry in place of {id}
conventions: {id}, the UTC date in place of {id}
the first pull request template GitHub would use, else today's body
no script: accord fills the template
500 lines: a file grown past it is a slop hit
90: an unclaimed ticket untouched for more than 90 days is an old draft in accord audit
feat, fix, refactor, perf, docs, test, build, ci, chore, revert, hotfix: the words {type} may take in a branch name
40: the most characters {slug} takes from a ticket title
full: every session start prints the rules, fetches and runs the worktree clean; quiet prints one line until /accord or a ticket's branch wakes accord
